columns: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,column_default,character_maximum_length,numeric_precision,numeric_scale,is_identity,identity_generation FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('jairoads_next','public') ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position
constraints: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS table_name,k.conname AS constraint_name,k.contype AS type,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true) AS definition,k.convalidated AS validated,k.condeferrable AS deferrable,k.condeferred AS initially_deferred FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('jairoads_next','public') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,k.conname
indexes: SELECT schemaname AS schema_name,tablename AS table_name,indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname IN ('jairoads_next','public') ORDER BY schemaname,tablename,indexname
policies: SELECT schemaname AS schema_name,tablename AS table_name,policyname,permissive,roles,cmd,qual,with_check FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname IN ('jairoads_next','public','storage') ORDER BY schemaname,tablename,policyname
triggers: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS table_name,t.tgname AS trigger_name,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) AS definition,pn.nspname AS function_schema,p.proname AS function_name,p.prosecdef AS security_definer FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('jairoads_next','public') AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname
grants: SELECT table_schema,table_name,grantee,privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema IN ('jairoads_next','public','storage') AND grantee IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres','PUBLIC') ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,grantee,privilege_type
storage: SELECT id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types FROM storage.buckets ORDER BY id
auditing: SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'version',version(),'current_role',current_user,'extensions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',n.nspname)) FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace),'pgaudit_log',current_setting('pgaudit.log',true),'pgaudit_role',current_setting('pgaudit.role',true),'pgaudit_log_parameter',current_setting('pgaudit.log_parameter',true),'pgaudit_log_rows',current_setting('pgaudit.log_rows',true),'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls,'superuser',rolsuper)) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')),'pgaudit_role_overrides',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'setting',config)) FROM pg_roles CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(rolconfig) AS config WHERE config LIKE 'pgaudit.%'),'schema_access',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r,'schema',s,'usage',has_schema_privilege(r,s,'USAGE'),'create',has_schema_privilege(r,s,'CREATE'))) FROM unnest(ARRAY['anon','authenticated','service_role'])r CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['jairoads_next','public','storage'])s)) AS snapshot
data_checks:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'captured_at',now(),
'table_counts',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(name,n) FROM (
SELECT 'lgus' AS name,count(*) AS n FROM jairoads_next.lgus UNION ALL SELECT 'engineers',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.engineers UNION ALL SELECT 'engineer_lgus',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.engineer_lgus UNION ALL SELECT 'user_accounts',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.user_accounts UNION ALL SELECT 'road_coverages',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.road_coverages UNION ALL SELECT 'maintenance_projects',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_projects UNION ALL SELECT 'maintenance_records',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_records UNION ALL SELECT 'monthly_updates',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.monthly_updates UNION ALL SELECT 'maintenance_documents',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_documents UNION ALL SELECT 'media',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.media UNION ALL SELECT 'audit_logs',count(*) FROM jairoads_next.audit_logs)q),
'duplicate_period_groups',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT project_id,maintenance_year,quarter FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_records GROUP BY project_id,maintenance_year,quarter HAVING count(*)>1)q),
'duplicate_period_excess_rows',(SELECT coalesce(sum(n-1),0) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_records GROUP BY project_id,maintenance_year,quarter HAVING count(*)>1)q),
'date_period_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_records WHERE extract(year FROM start_date)<>maintenance_year OR concat('Q',extract(quarter FROM start_date)::int)<>quarter),
'duplicate_engineer_links',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT engineer_id FROM jairoads_next.user_accounts WHERE engineer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY engineer_id HAVING count(*)>1)q),
'duplicate_project_roads',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT road_coverage_id FROM jairoads_next.maintenance_projects GROUP BY road_coverage_id HAVING count(*)>1)q),
'duplicate_months',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT maintenance_id,update_month FROM jairoads_next.monthly_updates GROUP BY maintenance_id,update_month HAVING count(*)>1)q),
'account_link_summary',(SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(q)) FROM (SELECT account_type,is_active,engineer_id IS NULL AS unlinked,count(*) FROM jairoads_next.user_accounts GROUP BY account_type,is_active,engineer_id IS NULL ORDER BY account_type,is_active)q),
'active_accounts_with_retired_profile',(SELECT count(*) FROM jairoads_next.user_accounts a JOIN jairoads_next.engineers e ON e.id=a.engineer_id WHERE a.is_active AND e.engineer_status='Retired'),
'active_assignments_with_retired_profile',(SELECT count(*) FROM jairoads_next.engineer_lgus l JOIN jairoads_next.engineers e ON e.id=l.engineer_id WHERE l.is_active AND e.engineer_status='Retired'),
'audit_notification_pair_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM jairoads_next.audit_logs WHERE (recipient_user_id IS NULL)<>(notification_message IS NULL))
) AS checks
bridge_checks: SELECT jsonb_build_object('public_users',count(*),'dd_linked',count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.dd_user_account_id IS NOT NULL),'legacy_linked',count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.user_account_id IS NOT NULL),'both_links',count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.dd_user_account_id IS NOT NULL AND u.user_account_id IS NOT NULL),'missing_dd_target',count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.dd_user_account_id IS NOT NULL AND a.id IS NULL),'email_mismatch',count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.id IS NOT NULL AND lower(u.email)<>lower(a.email)),'hash_mismatch',count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.id IS NOT NULL AND u.password<>a.password),'duplicate_bridge_groups',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT dd_user_account_id FROM public.users WHERE dd_user_account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dd_user_account_id HAVING count(*)>1)x),'canonical_accounts_without_bridge',(SELECT count(*) FROM jairoads_next.user_accounts d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users b WHERE b.dd_user_account_id=d.id))) AS checks FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN jairoads_next.user_accounts a ON a.id=u.dd_user_account_id
other_objects: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='jairoads_next' AND c.relkind IN ('v','m','f') ORDER BY c.relname
audit_config: SELECT coalesce(r.rolname,'ALL') AS role,coalesce(d.datname,'ALL') AS database,config FROM pg_db_role_setting s LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.setrole LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.setdatabase CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.setconfig) AS config WHERE config LIKE 'pgaudit.%'
tables: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS table_name,c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,c.relforcerowsecurity AS rls_forced,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('jairoads_next','public') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname
